tasks.title: Add hello.py script and its pytest test
tasks.spec:
Create exactly two new files at the repository root; do not modify any existing file.

1) `hello.py` (repository root):
- Python 3, standard library only.
- Define `def main() -> None:` whose body prints exactly `hello from the pipeline` (use `print("hello from the pipeline")`, which emits the message plus a single trailing newline).
- End the file with:
  if __name__ == "__main__":
      main()
- No CLI arguments, no logging, no configuration, no imports beyond the standard library (none are needed).
- Do NOT add `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`, `setup.py`, `__init__.py`, or any other file.

2) `tests/test_hello.py`:
- Must pass when `python -m pytest -q` is run from the repository root, with no `__init__.py` anywhere.
- Use one of these two approaches (pick one and keep it simple):
  (a) capsys approach: at the top of the test file insert the repository root into `sys.path` before importing, e.g.
      import os, sys
      sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
      import hello
      def test_main_prints_message(capsys):
          hello.main()
          captured = capsys.readouterr()
          assert captured.out == "hello from the pipeline\n"
  (b) subprocess approach: run the script with the current interpreter, e.g.
      import subprocess, sys, os
      def test_script_output():
          root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
          result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(root, "hello.py")], capture_output=True, text=True)
          assert result.returncode == 0
          assert result.stdout == "hello from the pipeline\n"
- The assertion must check the exact string `hello from the pipeline` followed by a single newline.

Context the worker needs: the repository is new and empty apart from existing CI config. CI only runs pytest when a `requirements.txt` or `pyproject.toml` exists; this task intentionally adds neither, so CI will pass without executing the test. That is accepted; do not add a manifest to work around it. The reviewer verifies AC1 and AC3 by reading the code. Do not touch `.github/workflows/**`, `README.md`, or any other existing file.
acceptance_criteria: `python hello.py` run from the repository root prints exactly `hello from the pipeline` followed by a single newline and exits with code 0.
`hello.py` defines `main()` that prints the message and calls it under `if __name__ == "__main__":`.
`python -m pytest -q` run from the repository root passes, with `tests/test_hello.py` asserting the exact output `hello from the pipeline\n`.
The change adds exactly two files, `hello.py` and `tests/test_hello.py`; no existing file is modified and no dependency manifest or `__init__.py` is added.
